title: Characterize object list 80036388

behavior.role: move a found non-head list entry to the owner head

arguments.a0: owner object; head link is loaded from +0x78
arguments.a1: target entry; its next link is at +0x74

behavior.null_paths: null a0 or a1 returns zero without mutation
behavior.search: starts from owner.head->next and follows +0x74 links until current==target; caller evidence establishes target is a reachable non-head entry
behavior.mutation_order: previous->next = target->next; target->next = owner.head; owner->head = target; return 1

caller.name: func_80018F3C_19B3C
caller.call_contract: checks the owner head separately, scans from head->next, stops at null, and invokes 80036388 only after a matching non-head entry is found; caller saves that entry across the call and ignores v0
caller.search_key: caller compares the entry field at +0x2C using masks 0x8FFFFFFF and 0x8FFFFFFE

behavior.callbacks: none observed in target or this call path
behavior.unknowns: behavior for a non-null target that is absent from the list is not a safe test domain; the caller establishes membership before calling

host_model.negative_control: replacing predecessor relink previous->next=target->next with previous->next=target is rejected by the expected post-move link assertions
host_model.limitations: G64-075 tests a ROM-derived host reference model because the native candidate remained nonmatching; it does not claim production C behavior or invalid-pointer safety

candidate_trials.variant: separate null guards with cached head local
candidate_trials.hypothesis: Translate the observed link search and move while keeping the owner head live across traversal.
candidate_trials.mismatch: original BEQZ owner guard; candidate BNEZ guard with a duplicated zero-return block

candidate_trials.variant: combined owner/entry guard with cached head local
candidate_trials.hypothesis: Share the zero return path through a combined non-null guard.
candidate_trials.mismatch: candidate uses branch-likely null checks to a shared exit with v0 zeroed in delay slots; original begins with a non-likely BEQZ and uses the a1 branch delay slot to load the head

candidate_trials.variant: nested entry-present block and owner-head reload
candidate_trials.hypothesis: Avoid caching owner.head across the link write so IDO can use the original previous/current registers and reload head for target->next.
candidate_trials.mismatch: candidate retains the inverted BNEZ owner guard; the first mismatch did not move from entry

toolchain.link_method: compiled single-function objects; linked with probe.py SUBALIGN(4) script at the original VMA using fresh G64-074 baseline ELF globals; extracted linked symbol compared against ROM bytes

decision.reason: All three allowed IDO variants linked at the original VMA but remained nonmatching and first differed at +0x00. The 108-byte target limit is three variants; no first-mismatch improvement occurred, so stop and retain GLOBAL_ASM. No full-ROM or inventory build qualified.
